simple.meaning: חֶמְדָּה (chemdâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “delight.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H2532. chemdah חֶמְדָּה noun feminine id. — ׳ח Hosea 13:15 8 t.; construct חֶמְדַּת 1Sam 9:20 3 t.; suffix חֶמְדָּתִי Jer 12:10 ; חֶמְדָּתֵךְ Ezek 26:12 ; חֶמְדָּתָם Dan 11:8 ; — desire of Israel 1Sam 9:20 followed by לְ before object of desire; ח ׳בְּלֹא = without desire 2Chr 21:20 (i.e. he lived as no one desired), see Öttli ᵐ5 (not ᵐ5 L ) ᵑ9 ; concrete: ׳כלחֿ ישׂראל 1Sam 9:20 and for whom is all that is desirable in Israel? so ᵑ9 ᵐ5 RV Dr; (>AV and on whom is all the desire of Israel? ); compare ח ׳ובאו כלהֿגוים Hag 2:7 (i.e. the desirable, precious things of all nations); elsewhere after construct as חֶמֶד ; especially ח ׳כלי Hosea 13:15 ; Nahum 2:10 ; Jer 25:34 ; 2Chr 32:27 ; 36:10 ; Dan 11:8 ; ח ׳שְׂכִיּוֺת Isa 2:16 , ח ׳אֶרֶץ Psa 106:24 ; Jer 3:19 ; Zech 7:14 , compare ח ׳חֶלְקַת Jer 12:10 ; ח ׳בתי Ezek 26:12 ; ׳ח נשׁים Dan 11:37 , apparently reference to some object of idolatrous worship, perhaps Adonis = Tammuz Ew Bev ( Astarte , Meinh).
